section_header: A27 RANGE SECOND GEAR CIRCUIT LOCK-UP OFF
title: A27 RANGE SECOND GEAR CIRCUIT LOCK-UP OFF

content.description: Hydraulic circuit diagram showing the transmission system in A27 range second gear with lock-up off. The diagram displays various solenoid valves, pressure control valves, hydraulic lines (shown in red for pressurized lines, yellow for specific circuits, and gray for unpressurized lines), clutches, and other transmission components. The diagram includes multiple solenoid assemblies at the top, various valve bodies in the center, and clutch assemblies throughout the circuit.
